facts.text: Existing container; owner proposed a foundation to support the container, a deck, a roof structure and a solid fuel heater; the authority is the applicant in the determination.
Authority refused building consent BC200367 under s50 because the application was incomplete and insufficient information was included to be satisfied on reasonable grounds.
Decision: authority correct to refuse building consent BC200367 under s50 (29 June 2022).
